name: agent-memory
instructions:
Maintain external agent memory: structured notes persisted outside the context window (NOW.md for the working thread, MEMORY.md for durable facts) so context can compact or reset while knowledge survives across sessions.

Capabilities:
- maintain a NOW.md working thread for the active task
- maintain a MEMORY.md of durable, cross-session facts
- decide what belongs in memory versus in an artifact
- recall memory into a fresh context pack with provenance

Canonical skill: .agents/skills/foundation/agent-memory/SKILL.md
handoff_description: Memory files are current, stale entries are reconciled, and every durable fact has a provenance line.
